name: start_ship_b2_blockout_v2
units: studs (Roblox frame: +Y up, front +Z; 1 Blender unit = 1 stud; FBX exported -Z fwd / Y up)

RampFlight1.note: 12 wide, ~13 deg, Y24->Y12, run ~52; origin at top-centre of the slope

RampLanding.note: 16x16 at Y12 on 4 posts, SW corner open, south outer rail solid ~5.5 high on east part, felt rails ~3.5 high

RampFlight2.note: 12 wide, ~13 deg, Y12->Y0, then flat felt apron ~16 long x ~14 wide; joins overlap ~0.5

rock_bumper.note: v1 was also 17 from the centreline but the 9-stud rock touched the apron edge; v2 is 21 so there is ~5 studs of clear sand between rock and apron edge (apron half width 7)

stern_castle.note: hull bulwark raised 10 studs around the cabin (x -160..-95, tapering to 0 at x -65) both sides plus a transom plate; low side left open at the ramp gap; walls are part of the Hull mesh and tilt with the hull; cabin walls/roof unchanged

bowsprit.note: moved from Rigging into the Hull mesh (hull 15 deg frame), thicker, sits on 2 bitts on the forecastle; masts stays end at its tip

tilt.note: kept the hull at 15: changing it would move the level-deck/hull cut and the tee/ramp footprint; the 3 deg extra on the masts reads fine. Deck, cabin, forecastle and ramps stay level

paint_prep.hull_strips: outer skin strips 0 and 21 (sheer strake), 2 and 19 (upper wale), 5 and 16 (lower wale), 10 and 11 (keel) use WoodDk; all other outer and inner planking uses Wood

cols.pivot_convention: ramp COL_* are boxes whose object origin is the box centre; piece-local COL names are prefixed COL_Flight1/Landing/Flight2 and positioned in their piece frame (pivot field in geom.json); other COL_* are world-space (Hull, Deck, Cabin, Bulwark, Outrigger, Pier, RockBumper, PlatRail)

scale_note: 1 stud = 1 Roblox stud. 5-stud character fits the 8 wide x 10 high cabin door; cabin interior is 16 high at the eaves (30 at the roof peak). Deck + cabin floor level at Y=24. Ship ~317 x 59 x 87 hull, mast tip ~160 up. Ramps 12 wide, felt-lined rails ~3.5 high.
deviations: Cabin is 43 deep (z -19..24) instead of ~55: hull interior at Y24 is only ~66 wide
Dressing_Glow and CupRef empty are extras
Tee pad is a thin felt slab
Sand, water, mound, 5-stud figures in previews are preview-only, not exported
Hull is visually closed but not watertight; hull COL boxes are scenery
